title: coap_backoff.h doc: payload-wins precedence claim doesn't match Python (prefers Max-Age)
description: Review observation (b7z9.45 closure, pass 1, non-blocking): lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/include/lichen/coap_backoff.h:33-36 says the retry_after precedence 'mirrors the Rust and Python clients: the duty-cycle CBOR payload's retry_after (when present) wins'. Per reviewer check, Rust uses the Max-Age option and Python prefers Max-Age over the payload; the C client only implements payload-or-default because the Zephyr blockwise callback does not expose the Max-Age option (documented in coap_client.c:297-302). Fix the comment to state that accurately (or align the C client with the reference precedence if Max-Age becomes observable). Tests unaffected: lichen/tests/coap_backoff passes 3x review.
